_note: Planted bugs, each proven by a test or by reading (2026-10-07). 'lines' = report lines that count as finding this bug. 'adjudicated' is filled from pilot responses and frozen with the pre-registration; it lists issues that are real-but-unplanted (real) or not real (fabricated), by line.

bugs.desc: _refill never caps tokens at capacity: after idle time the bucket holds unbounded tokens, so bursts exceed capacity
KeyedLimiter mutates/iterates self.buckets without a lock although buckets are meant for concurrent use: duplicate buckets per key, and 'dictionary changed size during iteration' in forget_idle
average_per_day divides by len(days); empty input raises ZeroDivisionError
top_regions sorts ascending, so it returns the lowest regions, not the top
get() does not move the key to the end, so eviction is by insertion order (FIFO), not least-recently-used
hit_rate divides by zero before any lookup
cached() treats a cached None as a miss: functions returning None are recomputed every call (and default=None conflates miss with value)
__exit__ returns True, silently swallowing every exception raised inside the with-block
get_json parses the body of non-retryable error responses (4xx, final 5xx path aside) without checking status, returning error pages as data or raising a confusing JSON error
config = DEFAULTS aliases the module-level dict: load_config mutates DEFAULTS, so later calls inherit earlier file/env values
bool(value) is True for any non-empty string, so APP_DEBUG=false enables debug
reserve() decrements earlier items before discovering a later item is short, and returns False without rolling back: not all-or-nothing as documented
release() overwrites stock with the order quantity instead of adding it back
daterange uses d < end, excluding end although documented inclusive (business_days inherits the error)
quarter() uses month // 3 + 1: March gives 2, December gives 5; should be (month - 1) // 3 + 1
MAC compared with != instead of hmac.compare_digest: timing side channel
password hashing is a single salted SHA-256: a fast hash, not a password KDF (bcrypt/scrypt/argon2/PBKDF2)
